question: Reproduce the descriptive linear least-squares association of measured body mass with flipper length in the supplied Palmer Penguins observations, with explicit unit conversion and complete-case accounting.

assumptions.statement: Upstream records and measurement-unit labels are taken as supplied; PCS does not attest field instrument accuracy.
Ordinary least squares describes these observed complete pairs only; linear biological adequacy, missingness independence, causal effects and population generalization are not asserted.
